cards.headline: PSG end Barça’s perfect start with a 4-2 win at the Parc des Princes
cards.summary: Paris Saint-Germain beat Barcelona 4-2 in the Champions League on Tuesday night. Désiré Doué opened the scoring in the 38th minute. Xavi Espart equalised on 55 minutes and Lamine Yamal made it 2-2 on 79. Vitinha and Fabián Ruiz scored the late winners. It was Barça’s first defeat of the season after 11 straight wins.
cards.body: The league-phase match at the Parc des Princes saw 40 attempts at goal. Joan García made a series of saves to keep the score down. Hansi Flick’s side twice came from behind before running out of energy in the final 15 minutes. PSG, the reigning European champions, remain on nine points. Barça drop to six. The Clásico against Real Madrid follows on Sunday at Spotify Camp Nou. Vinícius is banned for the league game. SPORT and Mundo Deportivo both led with the full-time score and noted the defensive absences of Koundé and Eric García. Official club channels confirmed the result shortly after the final whistle.

cards.headline: Dani Olmo ruled out for around a month with a left adductor injury
cards.summary: FC Barcelona confirmed that tests showed Dani Olmo has a left adductor muscle injury from a collision against PSG. The club expects him to be out for approximately one month. He will miss the Clásico on Sunday and the November international break. Fabrizio Romano reported the same timeline citing SPORT.
cards.body: Olmo left the pitch in the 26th minute after a challenge with Vitinha. Fermín López replaced him. The midfielder had started alongside Pedri and Bernal. Official statements in English and Spanish were posted on Wednesday afternoon. The Athletic and Mundo Deportivo both noted he is expected to miss El Clásico. Flick had already been managing minutes carefully ahead of the Madrid game. The injury list already includes Eric García (three to four weeks) and Koundé (ankle). Olmo’s absence moves the midfield options for Sunday. He had been one of the more advanced options in the three.

cards.headline: Xavi Espart scores on his full Champions League debut and draws praise from Flick
cards.summary: Xavi Espart equalised in the 55th minute against PSG with a finish after a pass from Fermín. The 19-year-old full-back made his official first-team debut against Newcastle and scored his first Champions League goal in the orange kit. Hansi Flick called his performance fantastic.
cards.body: Espart started at right-back in a defence that already lacked Koundé and Eric García. He handled Kvaratskhelia for long periods and joined the attack to score. Flick told reporters it looked as if Espart had been playing for three or four seasons. Pol Ballús wrote that the result will not go down in the history books but Espart’s performance will. SPORT highlighted that four players born in 2007 started: Espart, Yamal, Cubarsí and Bernal. Mundo Deportivo reported he was later touched in an ankle but the overall display was positive. The Clásico is four days away.

cards.headline: Lamine Yamal levels for 2-2 before Vitinha and Fabián seal the win
cards.summary: Lamine Yamal scored in the 79th minute to make it 2-2 after Lucas Hernández had restored PSG’s lead. Vitinha replied two minutes later from the edge of the box. Fabián Ruiz added a fourth in the 86th minute. Yamal’s goal was Barça’s 50th of the season.
cards.body: Yamal had lost the ball for Doué’s opener in the first half. He was more involved after the break and finished clinically for the second equaliser. Official reports noted the late burst of four goals in 14 minutes. PSG had already lost Dembélé and Kvaratskhelia to injury. Barça pushed forward after the 2-2 and left spaces that Fabián exploited. The result ends an 11-game winning run across all competitions. The next league fixture is the Clásico. Yamal leads the attack with Raphinha and Gordon when both are available.

cards.headline: Flick says titles are not won in October and PSG were the better side
cards.summary: Hansi Flick told reporters after the 4-2 defeat that it was a fantastic game from both teams but Barça made too many mistakes. He said PSG showed they were better. He added that titles are not won in October and the Champions League is decided in June.
cards.body: Flick praised Xavi Espart and Joan García. He noted the side were not fresh in the final 15 minutes and that the recovery after the previous match had not been ideal, though he refused to use it as an excuse. Mundo Deportivo and laSexta both led with the October line. The German said the team will get better and that the defeat brings lessons. He had already managed minutes with one eye on the Clásico. The squad returned to the Ciutat Esportiva on Wednesday for a recovery session. The next competitive match is against Real Madrid on Sunday.

cards.headline: Barça report PSG’s chainsaw tifo to UEFA after calling it disturbing
cards.summary: Barcelona lodged a complaint with UEFA over a tifo displayed by PSG supporters before kick-off. The banner showed a masked figure destroying the Barça crest with a bloodied chainsaw under the message ‘Massacre à la parisienne’. The club called the imagery deeply disturbing and said it incites violence.
cards.body: The Athletic, Reuters and La Vanguardia all reported the complaint. Additional banners with the message ‘PUTA BARÇA’ were also noted. The tifo was approved by PSG before the match according to L’Équipe. UEFA disciplinary rules allow sanctions for provocative messages. The standard first-offence fine is €10,000. The display appeared behind one of the goals as the players came out. Barça also reported offensive songs from the stands. The complaint was filed with the UEFA match delegate after the final whistle. The result on the pitch was 4-2 to the hosts.

cards.headline: Squad holds a recovery session at the Ciutat Esportiva after the Paris trip
cards.summary: Players who logged the most minutes against PSG did gym work while the rest of the squad trained on the pitch at the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper. The session took place on Wednesday. Focus now shifts to the Clásico on Sunday.
cards.body: Official club channels posted photos of the recovery session. SPORT reported that the squad returned to training with the Madrid fixture in mind. Olmo is already ruled out. Eric García and Koundé remain unavailable. Flick has spoken about treating each game in turn after the long winning run. The recovery comes after a high-intensity match with 40 shots. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou. Real Madrid sit behind Barça in La Liga after nine wins from nine for the leaders before Tuesday’s result.

cards.headline: Four players born in 2007 started against the European champions
cards.summary: Xavi Espart, Lamine Yamal, Pau Cubarsí and Marc Bernal, all born in 2007, started for Barcelona against PSG. SPORT published a photo of the same four together in the Infantil A team in 2021. Espart scored and Yamal equalised.
cards.body: Flick named a young defensive line with Espart at right-back and Cubarsí in the centre alongside Gerard Martín. Bernal started in midfield. The four had come through La Masia together. Pol Ballús highlighted Espart’s display in particular. The result was still a 4-2 defeat, but the inclusion of the group shows the depth available while Koundé and Eric García are out. The Clásico will test how many of them are required again on Sunday. Official channels later posted about Espart’s first Champions League goal in the orange kit he wore on debut against Newcastle.

cards.headline: Mundo Deportivo reports Xavi Espart was touched in an ankle after the match
cards.summary: Mundo Deportivo reported that Xavi Espart was touched in an ankle following the PSG game. The paper said the full-back had put in an excellent performance before the late issue. No official confirmation of a longer absence has been issued.
cards.body: Espart scored the equaliser and was praised by Flick for both his defending and attacking contribution. The report appeared on Wednesday afternoon. Barça already have Koundé out with an ankle sprain and Eric García unavailable for three to four weeks. Any further defensive problem would complicate the Clásico on Sunday. Cancelo and Gerard Martín started alongside Cubarsí and Espart. The club has not listed Espart as a major doubt in the medical updates posted so far. Training pictures from the recovery session did not show him limited. The next match is the league fixture against Real Madrid.
